checkpoint_lineage.training_access: all100 TRAIN cameras including NPR C; in-sample, not blind evaluation

native_depth_convention: Camera-Z: native ray-plane t is multiplied by rln = 1/sqrt(x_normalized^2+y_normalized^2+1) for depth, median_depth and topk_depth. Expected depth is alpha*T weighted mean; moment2 is unnormalized weighted second camera-Z moment. No GT surface claim.
qualification: All static views GS TRAIN and historically viewed; unused only in new LINE construction. Arc is exact inherited 33 cameras C7→C33; no recentering.
scope: Metadata, NPY headers and opaque byte hashes only; no decoded image pixels or array values inspected pre-freeze. Source inputs Mic only.
